title: Lahore High Court Orders Upload of MDCAT Question Papers
excerpt: The Lahore High Court has issued a directive requiring authorities to upload the Medical and Dental College Admission Test question papers.
body_html:
The Lahore High Court has issued a directive regarding the Medical and Dental College Admission Test. According to the ruling, authorities have been instructed to upload the MDCAT question papers online.

Further details regarding the implementation and timeline of the court's directive were not provided in the announcement.
